facts.display_text: Non-Hindus may not enter the temple complex; a viewing platform outside the wall gives a view of the temple.
facts.evidence: The temple is out of bounds for non-Hindus. However, one can get a view of the entire temple complex and take photographs from a raised platform erected specially for the tourists just outside the temple complex.

facts.display_text: Mobile phones and cameras are not allowed inside; lockers are available at the entrance.
facts.evidence: Cameras and other electronic items like mobile phones aren't allowed at the temple.

facts.display_text: Entry inside the temple is allowed only to Hindus.
facts.evidence: entry inside the temple is allowed only to Hindus.

facts.display_text: Entry ₹40 for Indians (₹35 by card); ₹600 for foreign visitors (₹550 by card).
facts.evidence: The entry fee for the renowned Sun Temple of Konark is Rs 40 per person for cash payments and Rs 35 for card payments. For foreign tourists, the entry fee is Rs 600 per person for cash payments and Rs 550 for card payments.
